caption:
What true success looks like in the Qur'an

Allah says the believers have attained true success: they humble themselves in their prayers and turn away from all that is vain. Let your next prayer be one where your heart is present.

Surah Al-Muminoon 23:1-3

What is one vain habit you can turn away from this week?

#truesuccess #khushu #surahmuminun #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
